name: Tesseract
description: Makes pictures, picture edits, effects and short video clips with their own sound from an MCP client, on the person's own Tesseract account: usage is charged to their Tesseract plan (free media first, then their allowance or balance), and every paid call takes a max_usd ceiling. Long work such as video comes back as a job to check with check_job. 8 tools. OAuth sign-in with a Tesseract account; hosted by Eightcell Labs, closed source.
author: Eightcell Labs, Inc.
